title: TaoTex: Boosting Texture Detail Fidelity for Native 3D Material Generation
title_zh: TaoTex: 提升原生 3D 材料生成的纹理细节保真度

paragraphs.en: Recent 3D generation models can produce accurate geometries while still struggling to reconstruct detailed textures. We propose a diffusion-based native 3D material generation model TaoTex, which faithfully recovers intricate textures through tailored strategies and improvements. First, we develop a data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets to bridge the data gap in public datasets. Training with these data significantly enhances the ability of TaoTex to recover challenging details such as text and patterns. Second, we design a multi-level feature fusion (MLFF) module to adaptively integrate local and global features of the conditional input, providing more complete texture cues for the diffusion model and thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity. To alleviate VAE reconstruction errors, we adopt a latent-to-pixel space loss transition, further improving the pixel-level details and generation quality. Finally, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, achieving accurate and consistent material reconstruction across views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in preserving texture details in both single- and multi-view settings.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的 3D 生成模型能够生成精确的几何结构，但在重建细节丰富的纹理方面仍存在困难。 我们提出了一种基于扩散的原始 3D 材质生成模型 TaoTex，通过定制的策略与改进，能够忠实地恢复复杂的纹理。 首先，我们开发了一个数据构建智能体，用于创建高频纹理的 3D 资产，以填补公开数据集中的数据空白。 使用这些数据训练显著增强了 TaoTex 恢复文本和图案等复杂细节的能力。 其次，我们设计了一个多级特征融合（MLFF）模块，能够自适应地整合条件输入的局部与全局特征，为扩散模型提供更完整的纹理线索，从而提升重建保真度。 为了缓解 VAE 的重建误差，我们采用了潜在空间到像素空间的损失转换方法，进一步提升了像素级细节和生成质量。 最后，我们通过引入可学习的视角嵌入，将 TaoTex 扩展至多视角输入，实现了跨视角准确且一致的材质重建。 大量实验表明，我们的方法在单视角和多视角设置中均显著优于现有方法，能更有效地保留纹理细节。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based Image-to-3D asset generation ( Chang et al., 2026 ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2024 ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) has advanced rapidly, yet existing methods struggle to faithfully reconstruct complex textures on 3D surfaces from input images, restricting their applicability to objects with simple textures rather than texture-rich categories. Current methods for generating materials on 3D assets typically operate either in view-space ( Hunyuan3D Team, 2025a ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; He et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) or directly in 3D-space ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Chang et al., 2026 ) . While view-space methods can leverage the priors of image generation models to assist texture synthesis, they still suffer from significant limitations. For example, texture baking may produce ghosting in overlapping regions, self-occluded areas require additional UV-space inpainting, and texture-geometry misalignment can cause projection artifacts. In contrast, generating material properties in 3D space inherently ensures global consistency and avoids the issue of self-occlusion.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散的图像到3D资产生成技术（Chang等，2026；Hunyuan3D团队，2024；Hunyuan3D团队，2025b；Hunyuan3D团队，2025a；Xiang等，2024；Xiang等，2026）已取得快速进展，但现有方法仍难以从输入图像中忠实地重建3D表面上的复杂纹理，导致其应用仅限于具有简单纹理的物体，而无法处理纹理丰富的类别。 当前生成3D资产材料的方法通常在视图空间（Hunyuan3D团队，2025a；Hunyuan3D团队，2025b；He等，2025；Wu等，2026；Huang等，2025；Zhang等，2026；Liang等，2026；Han等，2026）或直接在3D空间（Lai等，2026；Xiang等，2024；Xiang等，2026；Chang等，2026）中执行。 尽管视图空间方法可以利用图像生成模型的先验知识来辅助纹理合成，但它们仍然存在显著的限制。 例如，纹理烘焙可能在重叠区域产生重影，自遮挡区域需要额外的UV空间修复，而纹理与几何结构的不匹配则可能导致投影伪影。 相比之下，在3D空间中直接生成材料属性能够天然地确保全局一致性，并避免自遮挡问题。

paragraphs.en: However, existing 3D-space methods often fail to generate accurate patterns on planar or smooth surfaces. These regions lack distinctive geometric cues for the model to match with the conditional images, leading to incorrect or fragmented textures ( Fig. 2 ). We attribute this limitation to three factors: 1) Current public 3D datasets provide insufficient high-frequency textures, leaving the mapping from intricate patterns to simple surfaces unexplored by the model. 2) Conditional image features are semantically biased and lack detailed information. 3) Latent-space training is bounded by the reconstruction accuracy of the 3D VAE. Moreover, these methods either do not support multi-view input or perform poorly on it, despite its necessity in practical applications.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的三维空间方法通常无法在平面或光滑表面上生成准确的图案。 这些区域缺乏模型能够与条件图像相匹配的显著几何特征，从而导致纹理错误或不连贯（图 2）。 我们将这一局限性归因于三个因素：1）当前的公开三维数据集提供的高频纹理不足，使得模型尚未探索如何将复杂图案映射到简单表面。2）条件图像的特征存在语义偏差且缺乏详细信息。3）潜在空间训练受到三维 VAE 重建精度的限制。 此外，尽管多视角输入在实际应用中十分必要，但这些方法要么不支持该输入，要么在此类输入上的表现不佳。

sents.en: Moreover, these methods either do not support multi-view input or perform poorly on it, despite its necessity in practical applications.

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we propose TaoTex, a native material generation model with the capability to recover texture details from both single-view and multi-view inputs. For training this model, we develop a 3D asset data construction agent based on the Qwen LLM ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , which enables the automatic creation of diverse 3D assets with detailed text, logo patterns, and various material properties. To better capture fine details from the conditional images, we propose a Multi-level Feature Fusion (MLFF) module that adaptively integrates both semantic and local information, allowing a more faithful reconstruction. To mitigate the accuracy degradation caused by the 3D VAE, we use a two-stage training strategy, starting with latent-space loss and then switching to pixel-space loss. Furthermore, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by introducing learnable viewpoint embeddings. Combined with our constructed dataset and trained with a low-SNR schedule, this enables accurate and consistent texture reconstruction across different views.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 TaoTex——一种原生材料生成模型，能够从单视角和多视角输入中恢复纹理细节。 为了训练该模型，我们基于 Qwen LLM（Qwen Team, 2026）开发了一种三维资产数据构建智能体，能够自动创建包含详细文本、徽标图案和多种材料属性的多样化三维资产。 为了更好地捕捉条件图像中的精细细节，我们提出了一种多级特征融合（MLFF）模块，该模块可自适应地整合语义信息和局部信息，从而实现更忠实的重建。 为缓解三维 VAE 导致的精度下降问题，我们采用了一种两阶段训练策略：首先使用潜在空间损失，随后切换至像素空间损失。 此外，我们通过引入可学习的视角嵌入，使 TaoTex 能够处理多视角输入。 结合我们构建的数据集以及低信噪比（low-SNR）训练方案，该模型能够在不同视角下实现准确且一致的纹理重建。

sents.en: Furthermore, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by introducing learnable viewpoint embeddings.

sents.en: Combined with our constructed dataset and trained with a low-SNR schedule, this enables accurate and consistent texture reconstruction across different views.
sents.zh: 结合我们构建的数据集以及低信噪比（low-SNR）训练方案，该模型能够在不同视角下实现准确且一致的纹理重建。

paragraphs.en: The primary contributions of this work are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: Design a novel data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets for training, boosting the ability of the native 3D material generation model to handle patterns and text.
paragraphs.zh: 设计一种新颖的数据构建智能体，用于生成高频纹理的 3D 资产以进行训练，从而增强原生 3D 材质生成模型处理图案和文本的能力。

paragraphs.en: Propose the MLFF module, coupled with the latent-to-pixel space loss transition strategy, enabling TaoTex to reconstruct higher-fidelity texture details from the input images.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MLFF 模块，并将其与潜在空间到像素空间的损失转换策略相结合，使 TaoTex 能够从输入图像中重建更高保真度的纹理细节。

paragraphs.en: Develop a training strategy for multi-view reconstruction, incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, symmetric geometry data, and a low-SNR schedule, which enables TaoTex to support both single- and multi-view inputs while achieving globally consistent and seamless texture reconstruction via a generation framework that outperforms existing leading methods.
paragraphs.zh: 制定一种多视角重建的训练策略，该策略融合了可学习视角嵌入、对称几何数据以及低信噪比（SNR）调度机制，使 TaoTex 能够同时支持单视角和多视角输入，并通过一个超越现有主流方法的生成框架，实现全局一致且无缝的纹理重建。

paragraphs.en: Leveraging 2D diffusion priors ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , early methods optimize surface appearance via Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) ( Poole et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023b ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , which is computationally expensive and prone to over-saturation and Janus artifacts. To improve efficiency, TEXTure ( Richardson et al., 2023 ) and Text2Tex ( Chen et al., 2023a ) sequentially synthesize and project individual views onto meshes, but their view-by-view pipeline lacks direct cross-view interaction, accumulating inconsistencies across viewpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 通过利用二维扩散先验（Rombach 等人，2022），早期方法借助分数蒸馏采样（SDS）（Poole 等人，2022；Chen 等人，2023b；Lin 等人，2023；Liang 等人，2024；Zhang 等人，2024）来优化表面外观，但这种方法计算成本高昂，且容易出现过度饱和和“雅努斯”伪影。 为了提高效率，TEXTure（Richardson 等人，2023）和 Text2Tex（Chen 等人，2023a）按顺序合成并投影单个视图到网格上，但其逐视图处理的流程缺乏直接的跨视图交互，导致不同视角之间累积不一致性。

paragraphs.en: Recent methods adopt multi-view diffusion (MVD) to improve cross-view consistency ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Shi et al., 2023 ; Long et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent works improve texture quality through synchronized denoising, geometric conditioning, cross-view attention, and specialized projection strategies ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Zeng et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Bensadoun et al., 2024 ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025a ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . In parallel, Ink3D ( Han et al., 2026 ) employs video diffusion for continuous orbit-scan coverage. Other recent methods extend view-space synthesis from RGB appearances to PBR material properties, including albedo, roughness, and metallic ( He et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Despite substantial progress, view-space methods still suffer from cross-view inconsistencies in high-frequency regions, incomplete coverage under self-occlusion, and projection artifacts along depth boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 近期方法采用多视角扩散（MVD）来提升跨视角一致性（Liu 等人，2023；Shi 等人，2023；Long 等人，2024；Li 等人，2024）。 后续研究通过同步去噪、几何条件约束、跨视角注意力和专用投影策略提升了纹理质量（Liu 等人，2024b；Zeng 等人，2024；Cheng 等人，2025；Bensadoun 等人，2024；Hunyuan3D 团队，2025a；Hunyuan3D 团队，2025b；Liu 等人，2026）。 与此同时，Ink3D（Han 等人，2026）利用视频扩散实现了连续轨道扫描覆盖。 其他近期方法将视角空间合成从 RGB 外观扩展到了 PBR 材料属性，包括反照率、粗糙度和金属度（He 等人，2025；Huang 等人，2025；Wu 等人，2026）。 尽管取得了显著进展，视角空间方法在高频区域仍存在跨视角不一致问题，在自遮挡情况下覆盖不完整，并且在深度边界处会出现投影伪影。

sents.en: In parallel, Ink3D ( Han et al., 2026 ) employs video diffusion for continuous orbit-scan coverage.
sents.zh: 与此同时，Ink3D（Han 等人，2026）利用视频扩散实现了连续轨道扫描覆盖。

sents.en: Other recent methods extend view-space synthesis from RGB appearances to PBR material properties, including albedo, roughness, and metallic ( He et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 其他近期方法将视角空间合成从 RGB 外观扩展到了 PBR 材料属性，包括反照率、粗糙度和金属度（He 等人，2025；Huang 等人，2025；Wu 等人，2026）。

sents.en: Despite substantial progress, view-space methods still suffer from cross-view inconsistencies in high-frequency regions, incomplete coverage under self-occlusion, and projection artifacts along depth boundaries.
sents.zh: 尽管取得了显著进展，视角空间方法在高频区域仍存在跨视角不一致问题，在自遮挡情况下覆盖不完整，并且在深度边界处会出现投影伪影。

paragraphs.en: Native 3D methods model appearance directly in geometry-aligned spaces. Early works synthesize per-face colors using adversarial objectives ( Siddiqui et al., 2022 ) or continuous implicit fields ( Oechsle et al., 2019 ) . Modern diffusion-based approaches investigate varied representations, including colored point clouds, octree grids, UV parameterizations, and 3D Gaussian attributes ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2025 ) , each presenting trade-offs between resolution, efficiency, and graphics compatibility. Concurrently, unified frameworks generate geometry and texture jointly ( Hong et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024 ) , though their structural coupling restricts independent texture optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 原生 3D 方法直接在几何对齐的空间中对外观进行建模。 早期工作通过对抗性目标（Siddiqui 等人，2022）或连续隐式场（Oechsle 等人，2019）来合成每个面部的颜色。 现代基于扩散的方法研究了多种表示形式，包括彩色点云、八叉树网格、UV 参数化和 3D 高斯属性（Yu 等人，2023；Liu 等人，2024a；Yu 等人，2024；Liu 等人，2025；Xiong 等人，2025），每种形式都在分辨率、效率和图形兼容性之间存在权衡。 与此同时，统一框架能够联合生成几何和纹理（Hong 等人，2023；Tang 等人，2024），但其结构耦合限制了纹理的独立优化。

paragraphs.en: More recently, structured latent spaces have established a powerful foundation for native 3D appearance modeling. Pioneered by Trellis ( Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) , geometry and texture can be jointly parameterized within a unified Structured LATent (SLAT) manifold. Targeting texture synthesis on fixed shapes, NaTex ( Lai et al., 2026 ) introduces an explicit decoupling of geometric structure and surface color using a dual-stream autoencoder enriched with cross-latent feature aggregation. Building upon spatial sparsity and coordinate continuity, recent approaches perform diffusion on sparse voxel features or topology-agnostic texture formulations ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) , expanding the generative scope from raw radiance to complete physically based material channels ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) . While 3D-space methods effectively ensure global consistency and seamless surface coverage, existing frameworks fall short of resolving sharp, high-frequency appearance details.
paragraphs.zh: 近期，结构化潜在空间为原生 3D 外观建模奠定了坚实的基础。 以 Trellis（Xiang 等，2024；Xiang 等，2026）为先驱，几何与纹理可在统一的 Structured LATent（SLAT）流形中联合参数化。 NaTex（Lai 等，2026）针对固定形状上的纹理合成问题，通过引入一个包含跨潜在特征聚合的双流自编码器，实现了几何结构与表面颜色的显式解耦。 基于空间稀疏性和坐标连续性，近期方法在稀疏体素特征或拓扑无关的纹理表示上执行扩散（Zeng 等，2026；Liang 等，2026），将生成范围从原始辐射度扩展至完整的物理基材质通道（Yeo 等，2026）。 尽管 3D 空间方法能有效确保全局一致性和无缝的表面覆盖，但现有框架仍无法解决尖锐的高频外观细节。

paragraphs.en: TaoTex is a native 3D generative model based on the o-voxel representation ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , producing PBR materials (albedo, roughness, and metallic) from an input geometry and one or multiple images. Below, we present our data construction agent ( Sec. 3.1 ), key improvements for boosting texture details ( Sec. 3.2 ), and the extension of this backbone to multi-view setting ( Sec. 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: TaoTex 是一种基于 o-voxel 表示的本地 3D 生成模型（Xiang 等，2026），它可以根据输入的几何形状和一张或多张图片生成 PBR 材质（反照率、粗糙度和金属度）。 下面，我们将介绍我们的数据构建智能体（第 3.1 节）、提升纹理细节的关键改进（第 3.2 节），以及将该基础模型扩展到多视图设置的方案（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We prompt a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to produce Blender scripts that generate target meshes ( Fig. 3 ). The candidate mesh is then rendered and visually critiqued by the MLLM to guide iterative code refinement, with an iteration cap enforced to control runtime. Once approved, the constructed geometry undergoes automated UV unwrapping. Owing to the simple topologies of our target geometries such as cans, cups and boxes, this pipeline is able to autonomously produce meshes with well-structured UV layouts, which is essential for subsequent texture generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提示一种多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成 Blender 脚本，以创建目标网格（图 3）。 随后，候选网格会被渲染并由 MLLM 进行视觉评估，以指导代码的迭代优化，同时设置迭代上限以控制运行时间。 一旦获得批准，构建好的几何体将经过自动化的 UV 展开处理。 由于我们的目标几何体（如罐子、杯子和盒子）具有简单的拓扑结构，该流程能够自主生成具有良好结构化 UV 布局的网格，这对后续的纹理生成至关重要。

paragraphs.en: The UV layout mask acts as a spatial condition for an Image Generation Model (IGM) to synthesize textures in the UV domain, tasked with producing detailed text and patterns ( Fig. 3 ). To prevent perceptual artifacts, the MLLM evaluates the texture map by checking pattern sharpness and boundary alignment against the UV layout. The verified texture is bound to the geometric mesh alongside MLLM-prescribed PBR parameters (roughness and metallic), which yields high-frequency textured (HFT) 3D assets.
paragraphs.zh: UV布局掩码充当图像生成模型（IGM）的空间条件，用于在UV域中合成纹理，其任务是生成详细的文本和图案（图3）。 为避免感知伪影，MLLM通过检查图案的清晰度和与UV布局的边界对齐情况来评估纹理贴图。 经过验证的纹理会与几何网格结合，并附带由MLLM指定的PBR参数（粗糙度和金属度），从而生成高频纹理（HFT）的3D资产。

paragraphs.en: We employ Qwen-3.8 as the MLLM and Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the IGM. Although our agent natively supports end-to-end construction, in practice we prioritize efficiency: we first produce a fixed set of category-specific meshes, and subsequently synthesize a large volume of diverse textures over their UV layouts. This choice is driven by the fact that our task demands far greater texture diversity than geometric diversity. Constrained by the capabilities of current IGM models, the synthesized textures may not align flawlessly with the given UV layouts, but this discrepancy does not compromise the training of TaoTex in any manner.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Qwen-3.8 用作 MLLM，并将 Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro（Qwen Team，2026）用作 IGM。 尽管我们的智能体原生支持端到端的构建流程，但在实际应用中，我们更优先考虑效率：首先生成一组固定的类别专用网格，随后在这些网格的 UV 布局上合成大量多样化的纹理。 做出这一选择的依据是，我们的任务对纹理多样性的要求远高于对几何多样性的要求。 受当前 IGM 模型能力的限制，合成的纹理可能与给定的 UV 布局不完全吻合，但这种差异并不会以任何方式影响 TaoTex 的训练效果。

paragraphs.en: Incorporating inputs from additional viewpoints provides an alternative path to enhance texture fidelity. However, existing methods either lack native support for multi-view inputs or yield suboptimal results when generalized to this setting. To scale our pipeline to multi-view inputs, a straightforward approach is to concatenate the visual tokens of all input views before feeding them into ℱ θ \mathcal{F}_{\theta} . Nevertheless, the expanded token sequence exacerbates the difficulty of image-to-geometry feature alignment, leading to fragmented or incorrect texture generation ( Fig. 5 ). We address this issue through a simple yet effective strategy: adding a learnable viewpoint embedding to the features of each view to disambiguate tokens originating from different viewpoints. These embeddings are jointly optimized with ℱ θ \mathcal{F}_{\theta} and ℳ ϕ \mathcal{M}_{\phi} to ensure seamless integration, and remain fixed during inference. Our model accommodates up to four input views, which proves sufficient for the vast majority of objects. These viewpoint embeddings correspond to canonical front, back, left, and right positions, covering a 90-degree horizontal range and a 180-degree vertical elevation range.

paragraphs.en: Training on the HFT dataset is critical for properly optimizing the viewpoint embeddings. We intentionally curate this dataset with an abundance of symmetric primitives like cylinders and boxes, whose geometries are nearly indistinguishable across views. This structural ambiguity prevents the model from deducing viewpoints solely from shape cues, ensuring that the viewpoint embeddings are not bypassed. Meanwhile, rich multi-view appearance details compel the model to learn seamless cross-view transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 在 HFT 数据集上进行训练对于正确优化视角嵌入至关重要。 我们有意设计这个数据集，其中包含大量对称的基本几何体，例如圆柱体和长方体，它们的几何结构在不同视角下几乎无法区分。 这种结构上的模糊性使得模型无法仅凭形状线索推断出视角，从而确保视角嵌入不会被绕过。 同时，丰富的多视角外观细节迫使模型学习无缝的跨视角过渡。

paragraphs.en: Multi-layer DINOv2 features are projected via dedicated two-layer MLPs and concatenated along the channel dimension, followed by an SE-inspired ( Hu et al., 2018 ) channel attention gate that adaptively reweights channels via global pooling and a two-layer gated excitation MLP. The calibrated features are then compressed along the channel dimension by a three-layer fusion MLP, added to the mean residual of all projected layers, and normalized through LayerNorm, achieving efficient cross-layer feature fusion with enhanced training stability. Across all aforementioned MLPs, intermediate hidden layers consistently employ GELU activations, while the excitation module terminates with a Sigmoid function to generate attention weights.
paragraphs.zh: 多层 DINOv2 特征通过专用的双层 MLP 进行投影，并沿通道维度拼接，随后采用一种受 SE 启发的（Hu et al., 2018）通道注意力门，该机制通过全局池化和双层门控激励 MLP 自适应地重新分配各通道的权重。 接着，经过校准的特征由一个三层融合 MLP 沿通道维度进行压缩，并与所有投影层的均值残差相加，再通过 LayerNorm 进行归一化，从而实现高效的跨层特征融合并提升训练稳定性。 在所有上述 MLP 中，中间隐藏层始终使用 GELU 激活函数，而激励模块则以 Sigmoid 函数作为输出，以生成注意力权重。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune the material SC-VAE ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) on our dataset using 16 NVIDIA H20 GPUs (total batch size 64). Freezing the fine-tuned VAE, we train the DiT and the remaining modules under the same setup with a batch size of 16, using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . paragraphs.en: We compare TaoTex with existing SOTA methods for evaluation. In the single-view setting, we compare against TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , a 3D generation method, as well as view-space methods including UniTEX ( Liang et al., 2026 ) , Ink3D ( Han et al., 2026 ) , and MaterialMVP ( He et al., 2025 ) . In the multi-view setting, we compare against TRELLIS.2, MaterialMVP, and ReconViaGen ( Chang et al., 2026 ) , as the remaining baselines support only single-image conditioning. For TRELLIS.2, we implement the multi-view mode by switching the conditioning view during denoising, following TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2024 ) . To ensure a fair comparison of material generation, all methods use GT geometry except ReconViaGen, which cannot incorporate geometric input; therefore, we provide only qualitative comparisons for ReconViaGen. We also present qualitative comparisons with industry-leading commercial models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将 TaoTex 与现有的 SOTA 方法进行比较来进行评估。 在单视图设置中，我们与 TRELLIS.2（Xiang 等人，2026）——一种 3D 生成方法——以及包括 UniTEX（Liang 等人，2026）、Ink3D（Han 等人，2026）和 MaterialMVP（He 等人，2025）在内的视图空间方法进行比较。 在多视图设置中，我们与 TRELLIS.2、MaterialMVP 和 ReconViaGen（Chang 等人，2026）进行比较，因为其余基线方法仅支持单图像条件输入。 对于 TRELLIS.2，我们遵循 TRELLIS（Xiang 等人，2024）的做法，通过在去噪过程中切换条件视图来实现多视图模式。 为确保材料生成的公平比较，除 ReconViaGen 外，所有方法均使用 GT 几何结构；由于 ReconViaGen 无法整合几何输入，因此我们仅对其提供定性比较。 我们还与行业领先的商业模型进行了定性比较。

paragraphs.en: As our method focuses on the generation of complex textures, we select 30 objects with rich textures from TexVerse ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) for quantitative comparisons. We render views on both the conditioning and novel viewpoints of the generated objects to evaluate texture reconstruction and generation performance of all methods. For conditioning views, we report Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . For novel views, we report Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , CLIP-based Fréchet Inception Distance (CLIP-FID) ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , and CLIP Image Similarity (CLIP-I).

paragraphs.en: Quantitative results in Tab. 1 show that our method substantially surpasses all competing methods across metrics, confirming its advantage in material reconstruction and generation. Qualitatively ( Fig. 6 ), our approach faithfully preserves text and pattern details that other baselines fail to resolve. UniTEX ( Liang et al., 2026 ) leverages fine-tuned FLUX ( Labs et al., 2025 ) to synthesize multi-view textures, yet suffers from instability and severe texture fragmentation. While Ink3D ( Han et al., 2026 ) and MaterialMVP ( He et al., 2025 ) achieve plausible visual quality, Ink3D suffers from noticeable geometry-appearance misalignment stemming from its video-based orbit synthesis, whereas MaterialMVP struggles to preserve fine-grained texture details, ultimately compromising their quantitative performance.

paragraphs.en: Our method continues to lead all baselines under multi-view conditioning ( Tab. 2 ). paragraphs.en: Fig. 8 presents qualitative comparisons with commercial alternatives. paragraphs.en: TaoTex enables high-fidelity native 3D material reconstruction from single- or multi-view inputs via co-designed data, architecture, and training strategies. We leverage a designed data agent to create high-frequency assets, an MLFF module with pixel-space loss to maximize detail preservation, and viewpoint embeddings to ensure accurate multi-view reconstruction. Despite outperforming existing methods, TaoTex remains constrained by voxel resolution when reconstructing minute text or patterns. Since higher resolutions demand prohibitive GPU memory, scaling resolution under a limited memory budget to improve details presents a compelling avenue for future research.
paragraphs.zh: TaoTex 通过协同设计的数据、架构和训练策略，能够从单视角或多视角输入中重建高保真的原生 3D 材质。 我们利用一个设计好的数据智能体来创建高频资产，采用带有像素空间损失函数的 MLFF 模块以最大化细节保留，并使用视角嵌入来确保多视角重建的准确性。 尽管 TaoTex 的性能优于现有方法，但在重建微小文字或图案时，其表现仍受体素分辨率的限制。 由于更高分辨率需要巨大的 GPU 显存，在有限的显存预算下调整分辨率以提升细节，成为未来研究的一个极具吸引力的方向。
